name: ColorModeToggle
summary: Let users switch between light and dark color modes with persistence.

useWhen: Allowing users to choose a light or dark presentation for the application.
avoidWhen: When the product supports one fixed color scheme.
For a setting other than the color scheme; use Switch.

obligations: Reads bounded localStorage and prefers-color-scheme defaults without accessing browser globals during SSR.
Writes the Mux data-muxui-color-scheme hook on the document root.

behavior: The first render uses defaultMode, or light when it is not set, so server rendering and the first client render match.
localStorage and the operating system preference are read only after mount, never during server rendering.
After mount, the mode saved in localStorage under storageKey is restored when it is light or dark; any other saved value is ignored.
Without a saved mode, defaultMode is used, and without that the operating system prefers-color-scheme.
The current mode is written to data-muxui-color-scheme on the document root and saved under storageKey.
A change calls onModeChange with light or dark; restoring a saved mode does not call it.
mode sets the displayed mode and is still written to the document root and storage; the toggle does not change it, so the application updates mode.
The toggle does not listen for later changes to the operating system preference or to localStorage.
Unmounting the toggle leaves data-muxui-color-scheme on the document root.
Each ColorModeToggle keeps its own mode, so several toggles stay in step only when they share mode and onModeChange.
The icon shows the active scheme, not the one a press would select: a sun-like icon in light mode and a moon-like icon in dark mode.
The default name is Toggle dark mode. Keep it, or give a name that does not change with the mode.
To write the current mode beside the icon, control the toggle with mode and onModeChange and write the text from that state.
A controlled toggle restores no saved mode, so the application chooses the starting mode.
accessibility: Reads bounded localStorage and prefers-color-scheme defaults without accessing browser globals during SSR.
Writes the Mux data-muxui-color-scheme hook on the document root.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
